utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hello, Zara speaking at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Priyanka Kowalski. I’ve had unarranged overdraft fees taken and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Priyanka. I can see a £25 unarranged overdraft fee on your account on 14 October, and your balance is currently £312.40 overdrawn.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s exactly the charge I’m calling about. I didn’t expect it, and I don’t think it’s fair.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’m logging this as a complaint so we can look into the fee and what happened. I can’t say what the outcome will be at this stage.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Before I go further, I need to verify your identity. Could you tell me your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And could you confirm your postcode, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I’ll review the fee and the account notes, and you’ll hear back from us within five working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will you be the one looking into it?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of it and review the account myself. I’ll call you by 31 October with an update, even if we’re still investigating.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I’d appreciate knowing what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, Priyanka. I’m sorry again for the frustration. I’ve recorded your complaint and will call you by 31 October.
